Walt from Lost was kicked off the show because the actor hit puberty and couldn't realistically play the part of a 7 year old anymore.

That's not the worst reason to kick someone off a show I suppose, but it sticks out in my mind because Walt was such an important character to the story that had been planned. The entire first season revolved around supernatural shit that was supposedly being created by Walt, the season ended on a cliffhanger where supposedly we were going to find out explanations for all the strange stuff in the next season, and it was very strongly suggested that Walt had everything to do with it... Instead Walt left and the writers just dropped all of the existing plot lines and started making up random shit from that point on.

I got a strong impression that the "random mysterious shit that never gets resolved" formula was extremely popular with the fans and so the studio made them keep doing it well beyond the point where the writers were able to maintain the charade. I never finished watching the series, I can't imagine the ending was very satisfying.
